disposition_reason: Table 1 lists lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury results (mg/l) for 43 market kombucha products from the national standards body database, and Table 6 lists HACCP validation samples.

study.design: Secondary analysis of national standards-body conformity test results for market kombucha, plus processor survey and HACCP validation at one producer
study.market: Uganda market; results from Uganda National Bureau of Standards database
study.period_text: samples analysed between 2019 and 2020 (UNBS database); HACCP validation samples, dates not stated
study.method: Dry ashing at 400 C, then ICP-OES for Pb, Cd, Hg, As
study.lod_text: not stated; Table 1 prints As <0.05 mg/l and Hg <0.1 mg/l; Table 6 prints Pb <0.05, Cd <0.002, As <0.05, Hg <0.001 mg/L
